about.title: What is Dokodemo Doors?
about.bodyHtml:
A place where you can explore the world together, even when you're far apart

Dokodemo Doors is an online VR platform that offers a large collection of 360° VR travel videos from around the world.

More than 1,700 videos available

Although YouTube also has VR content, very few sites gather this many VR travel videos in one place.

Watch together in perfect sync

By starting the video at the same time, you and your friends can share exactly the same scenery at the same moment while talking or using gestures.

For more details, please see this page.

guide.title: What is this fan site?
guide.bodyHtml:
An unofficial site where you choose destinations from a 3D globe

I wanted to choose worlds from a 3D globe rather than from a simple text list, so I created this fan site with permission from the official site.

1. Subscription required to watch worlds

To enter and fully enjoy each world, you need a subscription on the official site. If you are not subscribed, trying to enter a world will redirect you to the subscription page.
Some worlds are available for free for a limited time. You can find them on the official homepage under “Recommended Worlds”.

2. Meta Quest 2 or later is recommended

You can technically watch on various devices, but to really experience the immersion of VR, a Meta Quest 2 or later headset is strongly recommended.
